commit.subject: LU-10026 mmap: add mmap support for compression
commit.message:
LU-10026 mmap: add mmap support for compression

This removes the EOPNOTSUPP for compression with mmap and
adds an mmap sanity test for compression.  This patch
removes all the restrictions for mmap, but we actually only
have unaligned read support right now, so the test is
deliberately simplified to only test reads.

A more complicated version which also tests mmap writes
comes later in the series, once read-modify-write is
supported.

The test tests mmap by copying data at several different
block sizes with several different compression chunk sizes.

tests: add mmap write test

This improves the existing mmap test to test mmap writing
as well as mmap reading.

DDN-bug-id: EX-7601
Was-Change-Id: I81840c7bbbefbc5c3bae6b270c2d94297a254d19

csdc: server reject FIEMAP/SEEK_HOLE|DATA on compr obj

Server return -EOPNOTSUPP if they get the FIEMAP and
SEEK_HOLE/SEEK_DATA requests upon compressed file objects.

DDN-bug-id: EX-8927
Was-Change-Id: I9f04fbb13a22cc83402d9989daab63a59367ff33

csdc: check ocd flag for fiemap/lseek

Currently client will not sending fiemap/lseek request to OST if
the file is a compressed one. This patch will check the
OBD_CONNECT2_COMPRESS flags and send the request if OST supports
compression as server would do the fiemap/lseek check instead.

DDN-bug-id: EX-8927
Was-Change-Id: I478cbf161044165fa31d4caa2336e9949fc626fe
